raw_text:
Native macOS menu bar speech-to-text app via Groq API: hold hotkey, speak, release, text appears. macOS 13+, Apple Silicon; Swift 5.0/SwiftUI.
`git checkout -b feature/<name>` before changes. After Swift file changes, always run:
`xcodebuild -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -configuration Debug build`
Tests: `xcodebuild test -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -destination 'platform=macOS'`
Also: `./scripts/build-with-timing.sh`; `./scripts/check-duplicates.sh`; `./scripts/generate-docs.sh`
Sandbox disabled. Carefully edit `whisperswift/whisperswift.entitlements`. Logs: `/tmp/whisperswift.log`.
Read relevant docs: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/BUILD_PERFORMANCE.md`, `docs/feature-flags/FEATURE_FL
